correctness.rationale: On t>=2 the hub is uniquely maximum-degree; both lifted hubs are uniquely maximum-degree in the connected bipartite cover. Removing them leaves 2k free K2 components (one from each shore of each peripheral K2) and the connected, side-marked B(K_r)=K_{r,r} minus matching for r>=3. The pointwise lifted-hub stabilizer is S_{2k} times the wreath factors, and the canonical shore exchange centralizes it; the expected lifted automorphisms preserve a pairing of 2k edge components and yield subgroup S_2 wr S_k. Group-order index follows. At t=1 the bouquet is a complete graph with stable crown cover. The graph is connected, contains triangles, and is open-neighborhood twin-free. Independent networkx isomorphism enumeration checked seven small mixed cases (not the infinite proof).
residual_risks: Bounded independent tests corroborate but do not themselves prove the infinite-parameter theorem.
